pipeline_and_headline.headline: In a backtest it may have seen in training, when choosing a battery's four lowest and four highest half-hours, Chronos-2 missed clearly less of each day's demand spread than a weather regression (115 against 425 MW a day). Where it disagreed with NESO's day-ahead forecast, outturn moved clearly towards Chronos-2, by 400.6 MW on average (90% interval 398.5 to 403.0); for the regression the figure was 2.2 MW (-2.0 to 6.3).
